style_line: Flanders, Christmas 1914, a frozen winter world.

location.where_when: Saxon front-line trench opposite the British line / Christmas morning 1914, dawn

landmarks.text: small fir trees set on the parapet
a dugout entrance with a hanging oil lamp

light.colour_key: deep night blue, many small warm candle points along the parapet

char_friedrich_brandt.name: the Saxon corporal
char_friedrich_brandt.description: Gefreiter Friedrich Brandt, a broad-shouldered 32-year-old Saxon soldier with a calm square face, close-cropped dark-blond hair, a full fair moustache, kind tired eyes, a field-grey round Feldmuetze cap with red band and cockade, field-grey 1907 tunic, grey greatcoat, black leather belt and boots

costumes.field: field-grey round cap with red band, grey greatcoat buttoned, the portrait card in the left breast pocket
costumes.button_given: field-grey round cap with red band, grey greatcoat buttoned with one button missing, the portrait card in the left breast pocket

characters.action: Friedrich's head and shoulders show above the German parapet
